title: @c15t/svelte: Svelte and SvelteKit cookie banner and cookie consent components
description: Cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit. Configure location-based consent policies, such as GDPR opt-in for EU visitors. Use headless state when you want your own design.
features: Works with Svelte 5.20 and later, and SvelteKit 2 and 3
On SvelteKit, `loadConsent` resolves the policy on the server, so the banner is in the first HTML
Prebuilt cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center with a theme system
Headless state for a fully custom design
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @c15t/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
prerequisites: Svelte 5.20 or later, or SvelteKit 2 or 3
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or local mode for development and tests
manualInstallation: Install `c15t` and import the Svelte components from `c15t/svelte`.
usage: Add `consentManifest()` from `c15t/svelte/vite` to `vite.config.ts`. It downloads your policy from `VITE_C15T_BACKEND_URL` (SvelteKit: `PUBLIC_C15T_BACKEND_URL`)
Wrap your app with `ConsentProvider` in `manifest()` mode
In SvelteKit, render `ConsentRoot` with the state `loadConsent` from `c15t/svelte/kit` returns; see the [SvelteKit quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/sveltekit/quickstart)
For the full setup, see the [Svelte quickstart docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/svelte/quickstart)

```svelte
<!-- src/App.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import {
    ConsentBanner,
    ConsentDialog,
    ConsentDialogLink,
    ConsentProvider,
    manifest,
  } from 'c15t/svelte';
</script>

<ConsentProvider mode={manifest()}>
  <main>Your app goes here.</main>
  <ConsentBanner />
  <ConsentDialog />
  <ConsentDialogLink>Privacy settings</ConsentDialogLink>
</ConsentProvider>
```
